C0208.title: Yunhe, Zhejiang Dismantles Massive Online Water Army Click-Farming Operation
C0208.summary: In April 2024, public security authorities in Yunhe County, Lishui, Zhejiang Province received a report about click-farming on an online shopping platform, and after three months of investigation successfully carried out a coordinated takedown, apprehending 15 suspects. The group developed multiple click-farming tools including 'Yunchuang Assistant' and 'Yiping Assistant', providing fake order services to over 5,000 merchants, generating more than 20 million fake transactions and over 40 million fake reviews and likes, with total illicit capital flow exceeding 30 million yuan, achieving a full-chain crackdown on click-farming.
